text.en: The students and their teacher go on a nature trail at Pachmarhi, Madhya Pradesh. A nature scientist, Abha Didi, guides them.

Have you seen a banyan tree with hanging roots, a coloured bird diving into water, a spider weaving a web, or butterflies around a flower? Nature is full of amazing animals and plants.
Students and their teacher go on a nature trail at Pachmarhi in Madhya Pradesh. Find it on a map of India.
At the forest gate they see tall trees and hear chirping birds.
Abha Didi, a nature scientist who studies plants and animals, welcomes them.
Students ask if they will see monkeys, deer, snakes, eagles and tigers. Abha says we have to find out.
She says we must not harm plants and animals. Rules for forests: do not feed birds, do not litter, stay quiet.

problem.en: Make three rules for a forest.

commonMisconceptions.en: Check the lesson again before answering.

points.en: A nature trail is a walk in nature.
Do not harm plants or animals.
